admission.justification: Realized across scripts/bootstrap-mcp-venv.sh, checkout_environments.py, application/runtime/install.py, and tool_answer.py, guarded by checkout-inventory and sync-rollback tests, and required for FAM-Z69A94's single-runtime transition boundary.

applicability: Registered Git worktrees of the agents-remember repository whose mcp/.venv exists, together with scripts/bootstrap-mcp-venv.sh and runtime_install.
conditions: A checkout environment is stale when its unresolved pyvenv.cfg home does not point at uv's contract minor symlink.

scripts/bootstrap-mcp-venv.sh moves a stale mcp/.venv aside under a checkout-directory flock with rollback restoration and recreates it without requiring --replace, while an already-current mcp/.venv still requires --replace (or returns 0 under --ensure).

runtime_install enumerates registered worktrees with NUL-delimited Git porcelain output and lists stale checkouts and their shell-quoted bootstrap commands without rebuilding or starting another checkout's Python.
exclusions: Registered checkouts that have no mcp/.venv directory.
Deleting the legacy ~/.local/share/agents-remember/python prefix or editing developer harness configurations.

evidence: Carried E6 re-exercised inside Light E9 on managed Python 3.14.10.

statement: The bootstrap rebuilds a stale checkout environment from its own lock and runtime_install lists all stale registered environments with their checkout commands.
title: Stale checkout environments migrate on bootstrap and appear in runtime_install
